module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    input  x,
    output z
);

    // State encoding: 3 bits for five states (000..100)
    reg [2:0] state, next_state;

    // State register (synchronous reset, active-high)
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset)
            state <= 3'b000;  // state 000
        else
            state <= next_state;
    end

    // Next-state logic
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            3'b000: begin // state 000
                if (x)
                    next_state = 3'b001; // 000 --x=1--> 001
                else
                    next_state = 3'b000; // 000 --x=0--> 000
            end
            3'b001: begin // state 001
                if (x)
                    next_state = 3'b100; // 001 --x=1--> 100
                else
                    next_state = 3'b001; // 001 --x=0--> 001
            end
            3'b010: begin // state 010
                if (x)
                    next_state = 3'b001; // 010 --x=1--> 001
                else
                    next_state = 3'b010; // 010 --x=0--> 010
            end
            3'b011: begin // state 011
                if (x)
                    next_state = 3'b001; // 011 --x=1--> 001
                else
                    next_state = 3'b010; // 011 --x=0--> 010
            end
            3'b100: begin // state 100
                if (x)
                    next_state = 3'b100; // 100 --x=1--> 100
                else
                    next_state = 3'b011; // 100 --x=0--> 011
            end
            default: next_state = 3'b000; // fallback
        endcase
    end

    // Output logic (Moore machine: z depends only on state)
    assign z = (state == 3'b011) | (state == 3'b100) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;

endmodule
